notes: DataDome bot-protection blocks plain requests (robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow; Allow: / for User-agent: *); accessed via curl_cffi Chrome-impersonation HTTP fetch, tier 1 of the access ladder - no browser automation needed. No single 'Seasonal' nav root exists; the site's main left-nav (Home & Furniture, Gifts & Seasonal departments) does not surface holiday nodes directly, so discovery relied on categories_sitemap.xml plus PLP verification (h1 + 'N products' result-count + product ItemList) for every candidate slug - the standard trap of a site scattering seasonal PLPs as flat, un-navlinked landing pages. Every row below was confirmed as a genuine product-listing page (h1 heading, exact displayed count, real product grid), not merely a plausible-sounding URL slug. Excluded as non-PLP/marketing/stale after inspection: /seasonal-decor-entertaining (Explore All editorial, no tile-heading), /kitchen-thanksgiving-dinnerware (dead slug, generic Anthropologie title, no content), /holiday-decor-gifting-pre-shop (AnthroPerks Preview loyalty-program teaser), /beauty-advent-calendar-preshop and /mothers-day-preshop (pre-launch preview pages, non-decor or trivial count), /holiday-candles (stale slug now serving generic 'Spring Candles', no holiday theming in products), /holiday-home-decorations-2 (stale slug now redirecting to 'All Sale'), /halloween-fall-doormats (stale slug, current products are plain generic doormats with no seasonal theming), /autumn-collection-assortment and /home-for-the-holidays-curation (curated 'Collection'/'curation' pages with content drift - furniture mirror/coffee table and 'Cozy Apparel' respectively, not seasonal-specific), /collection-top-rated-holiday-home (merchandising 'Top Rated' filter, not holiday-specific), /collection-bow-ornaments and /collection-sports-ornaments (0 products - 'Sorry, no products were found'), /swink-12-days-christmas-dinnerware (0 products). Duplicate-listing overlaps kept as one row per Rule 0.6 (identical count, same underlying listing reached via two URLs): /halloween-trend-shop duplicates canonical /collection-halloween-trend-shop (252); /collection-hanukkah-decor-entertaining duplicates /hanukkah-decor-entertaining (31); /collection-new-years-eve-decor-gifts-more duplicates /new-years-eve-decor-gifts-more (86). Christmas, Halloween, Hanukkah and Valentine's Day each have multiple genuine sibling PLPs so a name-only grouping row was added per rules Sec.9; other holidays with a single confirmed PLP were left as flat rows. 'Festive Candles' (46 products, /festive-candles) is flagged MANUAL REVIEW: the site labels it 'Festive & Seasonal Candles' but the actual product assortment (Flamingo Estate, Capri Blue, mise en place candles) shows no explicit holiday theming in names/descriptions, so the specific holiday association could not be confirmed from site context - genuine ambiguity per rules Sec.4/Sec.6, logged rather than decided. ADJUDICATION (2026-09-04): removed 'Festive Candles' row (https://www.anthropologie.com/festive-candles) - sampled products (Flamingo Estate, Capri Blue, mise en place candles) showed zero holiday-specific character in names/descriptions despite the 'Festive/Seasonal' page label; generic catalog mislabeled as holiday, not a genuine seasonal category.
